I wanted to come back once more. See if anything else had happened...
It's chaotic enough already. Every time you come through, it gets worse.
strings.그렇지 뭐. 피오니아가 공지를 올리고, 설명해도 잘 믿지 않아. 피오니아: Yes. Peonia posts notices and explains, but people won't believe her. Some even say she and the mayor were in it together.
strings.곧 빛의 연합에서 사람을 보내올 거야. 피오니아가 요청을 한 것도 있지만: The Alliance of Light will send someone soon. Peonia requested it, but the funny thing is, the people who wouldn't believe her back down as soon as they hear someone from Lumen is coming.
They don't even know who's been doing all the work for Mars...
strings.너 말이야. 혹시 괜찮은 지도 있어?: Say, do you have a decent map?
strings.쥬드 왕국 인간들, 괜찮은 지도라면서 보여주는 게 이거야. 대륙 중심부는: The people of the Kingdom of Jude call this a decent map. Look at it. It doesn't show the center of the continent at all.
strings.역시 빛의 연합 손을 빌려야 할까? 사실 이 대륙의 최고 정보는 루맨에: Will I have to ask the Alliance of Light after all? The best information about this continent is in Lumen...
strings.미안한데, 너 루맨에 다녀와 줘. 나는 계속해서 아발론의 동향을 살펴야: Sorry, but go to Lumen for me. I need to keep watching Avalon. And those Demigods too...
strings.대륙 중심부가 잘 나온 지도면 되죠?: A detailed map of the central continent, right?
strings.그래. 요즘 지스카드 그분 루맨에 계시다며? 그럼 가서 물어봐. 교단에는: Yes. Ziskad is in Lumen these days, isn't he? Go ask him. I'll tell the order the goddess's messenger helped us.
The order will give you some kind of reward. Hopefully something besides more work...
It's all right. I'll be back.
strings.(지스카드 님은 지금 영지에 계실까?): (I wonder if Ziskad is at his estate now.)
strings.(지스크 영지에 들어서자마자 동물들이 잔뜩 놀라 사라진다.): (The moment the adventurer enters Zisk's Estate, the animals startle and scatter.)
strings.자네, 왔나? 그런데 무슨 일이지? 엘의 일 때문인가?: You're back? What brings you? Is it about El?
strings.네? 엘에게 무슨 일이 생겼나요?: What? Has something happened to El?
No. She's just resting. She looked tired, so I told her to take a break.
I see. I'm glad she's all right.
strings.그렇지. 그건 그렇고 자네, 그냥 온 건 아닐 테니 말해보게. 무슨 일이: Indeed. Anyway, you must have a reason for coming. Tell me, what is it?
strings.(지스카드에게 로즈마리에 대해 설명하고 괜찮은 지도를 구하러 왔다고 이야: (I explain Rosemary's request and tell Ziskad I've come to find a good map.)
strings.그 배틀로드가 아직 이스트랜드에 있었군. 데미갓들이 통 보이지 않는 걸: That Battlelord is still in Eastland, then. And the Demigods have scarcely been seen... Hmm...
strings.자네가 다녀간 이후, 호숫가 근처에서 하울왕국의 서적들이 발견됐네. 뭔가: After your last visit, books from the Kingdom of Howl were found near the lake. Some seem to be missing... Perhaps...
strings.자네라면 발견할 수 있을지도 모르겠군. 어떤가? 한번 가보겠나?: You might be able to find them. What do you say? Will you take a look?
Pay them no mind. Overthinking can make even simple things impossible.
I'll remember. And about what happened then...
Things will work out with Medea. Don't worry too much.
Hearing you say that eases my mind, Ziskad.
strings.나중에 때가 되면 메디아가 부를 테니 기다리게. 그리고 호숫가는 레테가: Medea will call you when the time is right. Wait until then. And be careful at the lake. It's dangerous even with Lethe gone...
I'll look into Baral. There's no need for you to investigate separately.
strings.(로즈마리가 들고 있던 편지를 갈기갈기 찢는다.): (Rosemary tears the letter in her hands to shreds.)
You look angry. Have you heard something about the Demigods?
strings.교단에서 편지를 보내왔어. 봉인 같은 게 특별하지 않아서 그냥 보긴 했지: The order sent a letter. It wasn't under any special seal, so I read it...
Belosh has disappeared. They've only now discovered what happened to him.
strings.바이스의 공격이 단순히 신성력 봉인인 줄 알았어. 하지만, 정신이 붕괴된: We thought Weiss's attack had merely sealed his divine power. But his mind had collapsed.
strings.교단에서 붙잡고 기도하고 치유 훈련을 계속 진행했지만, 계속해서 빠져나가: The order kept him there, praying and continuing healing treatments. But he constantly tried to escape, giving them no end of trouble.
strings.힘이 없어도 데미갓은 데미갓…. 모두를 쓰러뜨리고 사라졌다고 해. 행방불: Even without his power, a Demigod is still a Demigod... He defeated everyone and vanished. Now he's missing.
strings.복수라도 하려는 걸까요?: Is he trying to get revenge?
strings.벨로쉬라면 가능해. 신을 따르면서 쓸데없는 부분에서 자존심이 강하고,: Belosh might. He serves a god, yet he's arrogant and proud of the most pointless things.
Enough to irritate even the calm Frozen sometimes.
Well, he'll handle it himself. And accept the consequences himself.
strings.이야, 이거 정말 훌륭한 지도네. 하울 왕국? 예전에 이스트랜드에서 제일: Wow, this is excellent. The Kingdom of Howl? As expected of what was once Eastland's greatest kingdom... With this, I can get closer to Avalon.
Thank you. I think I can manage now.
The order will reward you, but I'll give you something too. Good information. Listen carefully.
Yes. A message from a god.
strings.얼마 전에 교단으로 신의 메시지가 내려왔어. 정확히는 신탁을 받는 날을: The order recently received a divine message. More precisely, it announced the day the oracle would be delivered.
strings.너라면 어디 거치지 않고 이리스 님을 통하면 되긴 하지만, 이리스 님은: You can go straight through Iris, of course. But she is still incomplete, so...
I'm not criticizing her. Take that as you will.
strings.(…신을 흉보는 배틀로드라 참 신기하단 말이지.): (...A Battlelord speaking ill of a god. How curious.)
strings.신탁은 보통 여러 형태로 나타나는데, 먼저 예고 같은 게 나와. 어디서: Oracles take many forms, but usually there's advance notice. "I shall deliver my message here, in this way." That sort of thing.
strings.이번엔 세레스 교단의 신전이 아니더라고. 메시지에 이면 어쩌고 하는데 뭔: This time, it isn't a temple of the Order of Seres. The message mentioned the Reverse Side or something. Whatever that means...
strings.내 이야기에 관심이 있으면 정보를 모아봐. 이리스 님과 직접적으로 연결된: If you're interested, gather more information. I thought it might help someone directly connected to Iris, so I told you.
strings.윽, 그런 표정으로 고맙다고 하지마. 프로즌하고 비슷한 표정으로 날 보지: Ugh, don't thank me with that expression. Don't look at me the way Frozen does!!
strings.너 조금 안 본 사이에 많이 변해서 적응하기 힘드네. 후우…. 그런데 저: You've changed so much in such a short time, it's hard to get used to. Sigh... Who are those people? I've never seen them in Phobos.
strings.(분명 눈이 마주쳤는데…. 잠깐, 이 사람들 어디 갔지?): (Our eyes definitely met... Wait, where did they go?)
strings.아, 됐고. 난 쉴래. 어우, 귀찮아. 너는 어떻게 할래? 같이 한 잔: Oh, never mind. I'm taking a break. What a bother. What about you? Want a drink?
No, I've thought of somewhere I need to go.
Take care, Rosemary. See you again.
Sure... Next time, let's meet when neither of us has anything to do.
strings.(라클렛과 젤릭…, 분명 데이나가 보낸 것 같은데. 에스닐로 가서 데이나: (Raclette and Jelic... Dayna must have sent them. Should I go to Esnil and ask her? It can't be anything ordinary. An oracle, the Reverse Side... Obvious enough, but still.)
strings.(데이나가 당황한 듯 어색한 미소를 지으면서 반긴다.): (Dayna greets the adventurer with an awkward, flustered smile.)
You already know, so I won't deny it. Come sit here.
strings.차 마실래? 디저트는 거기 있는 것 중에 먹고 싶은 거 골라. 오늘도 젤: Tea? Help yourself to whichever dessert you like. Jelic dropped off another pile today.
strings.그러고 보니 내일이 젤릭의 신작이 나오는 날이었나? 이쯤 되면 항상 소레: Come to think of it, is tomorrow the day Jelic unveils his new creation? An elf mage named Soleil always comes to wait around this time.
strings.역시 그 마법사와도 친분이 있구나. 아, 미안. 목소리 요정이 허공해에: Of course you know that mage too. Oh, sorry. The voice fairy fell into the Void Sea.
strings.%s 씨는 모르는구나. 이야기가 주제에 벗어나거나 길어지면 프레이오스에선: You haven't heard that, %s? It's an expression we use in Freios when a conversation wanders off-topic or goes on too long.
strings.그건 그렇고, 마르스에서 라클렛과 젤릭을 봤지?: Anyway, you saw Raclette and Jelic in Mars, didn't you?
strings.별 건 아니고…. 포보스 근처 지역에 일이 있어 확인차 보냈어. 큰 건: Nothing much... I sent them to check on something near Phobos. It's nothing major.
strings.우리는 %s 씨가 마르스를 떠난 줄 알았거든. 그래서 봤어도 일단 모른: We thought you'd left Mars, %s. They must have pretended not to notice you because they were working.
If they were on duty, I understand.
strings.믿어주니 고마워. 그래서 언니의 칙서는 받았어?: Thank you for believing me. Have you received my sister's imperial decree?
You know about it. I have, but it isn't time yet.
strings.시간이 조금 남은 모양이네. 그러면 내가 한 가지 이야기해도 될까? 꽤: So there's a little time left. May I tell you something? I think it's useful information...
Think of it as organizing your thoughts while you wait. That might help.
We recently found traces of someone's attempt to connect the Demon Realm to this world.
The Reverse Side's power is tremendous there. It may be the place my sister intends to name.
strings.에이도스라는 이름을 가진 지역이야. 흔히들 '성역'이라 부르지. 성기사들: A region called Eidos. People usually call it the Sanctuary. Holy knights reside there too.
You look as though you want to know more.
strings.사실 나도 잘 몰라. 아는 게 거기까지거든. 언니라면 무슨 일이 어떻게: Honestly, that's all I know. My sister could use her foresight to see what will happen, but...
I don't know if her body could withstand it...
strings.아, 아니야. %s 씨, 이건 못 들은 거야. 내가 언니를 걱정하는 것: Oh, never mind. You didn't hear that, %s. It makes it sound like I'm worried about her.
strings.네, 그래서…. 다음엔 제가 성역으로 갈지도 모르는 거군요. 그런데 성역: Right. So... I may be going to the Sanctuary next. How do I get there?
strings.(데이나 씨는 친절하게 다 이야기해준단 말이지.): (Dayna really does kindly tell me everything.)
Only a few days left, right? Until you can open my sister's decree...
Yes. I'll need to go to Dragon Valley then.
Then get plenty of rest until then.
Thank you for saying so. I'll be going now.
strings.다른 건 안 궁금해?: Aren't you curious about anything else?
I'll learn about what hasn't happened yet in its own time.
I suppose that's why everyone likes them. My sister, Shiina... all of them.
